description: Real-CVE recall corpus (issue #105). Each case is a commit-pinned PRE-FIX checkout of a real project at a real vulnerability, labeled with the sink file/line and CWE. Checkouts are fetched on demand into cache/<id>/ by scripts/fetch_cve_cases.py and are NOT committed. Unfetched cases are skipped. Scored through the same file+line+CWE-class grader as the vuln_app corpus, so a hit means we detect the actual bug by the right vulnerability class. See README.md for how to add a case.

schema.id: stable slug, also the cache dir name (e.g. 'CVE-2024-XXXX-projname')
schema.cwe: integer CWE id used for class-consistency grading
schema.commit: pinned PRE-FIX commit SHA (the vulnerability must be present at this commit)
schema.subdir: optional path under the checkout to scan (defaults to repo root)
schema.sink_file: repo-relative path of the vulnerable sink file
schema.sink_line: approximate 1-based sink line (graded within VULN_APP_SINK_WINDOW lines)
schema.pool: 'regression' (gates CI) or 'holdout' (generalization signal only); defaults to regression
